documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, crossing the H1,000 Crore revenue milestone for the first time with revenues reaching H1,053.19 Crore. Management highlighted the successful commissioning of the Alu-Zinc coating line and augmentation of existing colour-coated lines, driving strong growth in operating leverage, profitability, and return metrics. The company plans further expansion including a new colour-coated line in FY 2026-27 and a cold-rolling mill by December 2027 to support its long-term revenue targets. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the financial year 2024-25 in its Annual Report, noting a revenue of Rs 584.18 Crore and a PAT of Rs 11.70 Crore. Management highlighted ongoing capacity expansions, including a new Alu-Zinc production line and a colour coating line expansion funded through internal accruals.

guidance.claim: The company expects the new integrated Alu-Zinc production line to result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.
guidance.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.

guidance.claim: The colour coating manufacturing line expansion investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing H125 Crore in two successive expansion programmes.
capex_expansion.quote: At Manaksia Steels, we are investing H125 Crore in two successive expansion programmes.

capex_expansion.claim: The second expansion programme will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line that will enhance capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened during the year on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 4.40% for FY 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company generated H16.56 Crore in cash profit during the year under review, which was deployed to address capital expenditure and working capital needs.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company generated H16.56 Crore in cash profit during the year under review. This was deployed to address capital expenditure and working capital needs.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

management_commitments.claim: The second colour coating expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of the current financial year, generating revenues from the last quarter onwards.
management_commitments.quote: This decisive 175% expansion programme is expected to go on stream during the latter part of this current financial year, generating revenues for the Company from the last quarter onwards.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning of its new capacities.
management_commitments.quote: The Company expects to report a better performance from FY 2025-26 onwards following the commissioning its new capacities.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
